title: Dedicated: Changing a Capacity Reservation (2027)
author: Soojin Lee
body:
## Changing a reservation
Dedicated customers change reserved capacity through their account team, with 30 days' notice. Increases can start sooner when capacity is available.

## Billing
The new reservation is billed from the first full month after it starts. Reductions below the contracted minimum need a contract amendment.

## Support
Support doesn't change reservations. Tell the customer their account team handles it.

_Last reviewed 2027-02-21._
